name: pop-text
title: Pop text
description: A word or two that lands over the picture to stress what the voice says: pops (or rises) in, settles, and fades out on the element's end. Big, bold, outlined, readable over any footage. One at a time.

text.description: The words, shown upper-cased. \n breaks the line. Keep it to one to three words.

color.description: Fill color: #rrggbb or a kit token such as kit:color.accent.

stroke.description: Outline color, drawn outside the letters.

size.description: Letter size in pixels of the 1920x1080 design canvas.

y.description: Vertical center, design pixels. 840 sits in the lower third, clear of captions at 960.

tilt.description: Rotation in degrees, clockwise. A small tilt reads as energy.

enter.description: pop: scales up from half size with a little overshoot. rise: slides up and fades in. cut: just appears.

max_width.description: Lines wrap at spaces beyond this width.

position.$expr: props.enter === 'rise' ? {keys: [{t: 0, v: [props.x, props.y + 70], ease: 'out-cubic'}, {t: 0.2, v: [props.x, props.y]}]} : [props.x, props.y]

changelog.changes: First version: pop, rise and cut entrances, outline and drop shadow, fade out on the element's end.
